source: Raw XML exported by 1C 8.3.27.2074 from isolated infobases after parent and extension import, check and apply. Both extension descriptors were imported and exported through a second independently created infobase and retained byte-exact.

extension-common-module.xml.source: Raw platform export after importing CommonModule.Server=false with PropertyState Server/Notify; byte-exact after a second independent infobase import/export.

parent-common-module.xml.source: Raw platform export of the isolated parent configuration used for the CommonModule.Server/Notify probe.

extension-common-module-inherited.xml.source: Raw platform export of an adopted CommonModule imported with only ObjectBelonging, Name, Comment and ExtendedConfigurationObject: none of the eight CommonModule properties is written; the platform added only PropertyState Module/Extended for the extension module. Byte-exact after a second independent infobase import/export (#1304).

extension-common-module-environment-only.source: Raw platform export of an adopted CommonModule imported with the six environment flags but without Privileged and ReturnValuesReuse; the platform keeps exactly that set. Byte-exact after a second independent infobase import/export (#1304).

parent-common-module-cache.xml.source: Raw platform export of the parent CommonModule adopted by extension-common-module-inherited.xml; its Privileged=true and ReturnValuesReuse=DuringRequest are not copied into the extension descriptor (#1304).
